title: sign: P-384 key produces ECDSA_WITH_SHA_256 OID (wrong)
description: sign() hardcodes DigestAlgorithm::Sha256 and calls signature_algorithm_oid(cert, Sha256), which returns ECDSA_WITH_SHA_256 for any EC key. A P-384 signing key should produce ECDSA_WITH_SHA_384. Strict receivers (e.g. OpenSSL verify, Java) will reject the SignedData because the algorithm OID does not match the key type. Trigger: caller provides a P-384 EC signing key to sign().
